label: This human life is the most precious opportunity alone: his paragraph as published (43, 6)
his: As I mentioned in my [nibbana article](http://nibbana.u-dont-exist.com/), I’ve had my most profound spiritual peak experiences and realizations when I had the least interest in continued existence. And the Buddha taught in [MN 129](https://suttacentral.net/mn129/en/sujato), attaining a human birth is as rare and precious as it would be for a one-eyed turtle to pop his head up through a hoop on the surface of the vast ocean. You won the cosmic jackpot, so don’t throw away the ticket before you open the envelope to find it!
